narrative.details: This flame, stolen from the heart of Ironforge itself, floods you with warmth. This raw power is foreign to you, but the Talespinner might know more...
narrative.objectives: Return the Flame of Ironforge to the Festival Talespinner.
narrative.offerRewardText: This hearty flame must be from the halls of Ironforge; it's as stalwart as the dwarves themselves. A fine catch, adventurer. If I had the fires of the other cities... ah, but never mind. Here is your payment.
narrative.requestItemsText: You're practically glowing, friend. What do you have there?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 60, 9,900 XP in all.
